name: vyom-crm
description: Vyom CRM - Accounting & finance consulting firm CRM

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.db:init: psql -U postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE vyom_crm;" && psql -U postgres -d vyom_crm -f database/schema.sql
